current_snapshot.note: The regenerated Q1 review cycle 1 ledger collapses exact duplicate source inputs, so row_count is unique ledger rows and current_source_row_count is physical source objects scanned.

future_changed_hash_representation.source_row_identity: source_row_id is derived from audit identity fields { path, file_name }.
future_changed_hash_representation.version_identity: source_version_id is derived from source_row_id, stable source-row content hash, and processed_version; row state and volatile mtime fields are excluded.
future_changed_hash_representation.changed_hash_behavior: A future source-state row with the same source_row_id and a different stable source-row content hash is represented as an additional source_version_id for that source_row_id.
future_changed_hash_representation.addressability: DPO or later intake rows must cite the intended source_version_id, not only source_row_id, when a source has multiple versions.
future_changed_hash_representation.current_retention_proven_by_snapshot_not: No current multi-version source exists in the snapshot, so actual changed-hash retention must be exercised by the Q1-03 rerun scenario matrix rather than invented here.
